articles.title: Nasdaq invests $100 million in Kraken parent company Payward at $21 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The investment expands a strategic partnership to bring tokenized, voting-enabled equities to crypto exchange users.

articles.title: Nasdaq invests $100M in Kraken parent at $21B valuation: Report
articles.snippet: Nasdaq invested $100 million in Payward as part of its push toward tokenized stock products with round-the-clock trading.

articles.title: Trezor, BitBox warn users about fake hardware wallet security alerts
articles.snippet: BitBox said multiple Bitcoin companies appeared to have been targeted through a shared newsletter provider, while Trezor confirmed a breach at its email service.

articles.title: German finance ministry proposes 25% crypto tax starting 2028: Report
articles.snippet: The German Ministry of Finance is reportedly seeking to impose a 25% tax on cryptocurrencies, departing from current laws that make crypto gains tax-free after one year of holding.

articles.title: Nasdaq Invests $100M in Kraken Parent Payward at $21B Valuation
articles.snippet: Deutsche Börse's April stake implied a $13.3 billion valuation. Five months on, Nasdaq is paying at $21 billion.
